_about: How each saved output in data/cached/ was written: the date, and per page the seconds it took on each device it was timed on. The first device is the one the saved output comes from. server_start_s: how long its vLLM server took to start, before the first page.

paddleocr_vl.with: paddleocr 3.7.0, PaddleOCRVL(pipeline_version="v1.6"), its VLM on PaddleOCR's vLLM server (vLLM 0.10.2), as src/dudemo/live.py runs it
